$comment: Dependency advisories the owner has accepted as not reachable in production.
scripts/ops/publish-quality-report.mjs leaves a finding listed here out of the
Issue Manager snapshot, so it stops reopening as a regression and re-creating a
remediation task on every push to main. It does NOT touch the npm audit ratchet:
quality/baselines/npm-audit-baseline still counts these, and the justification
An acceptance lapses on its own, and the finding is published again, when:
- npm audit reports a fix for the package (fixAvailable), or
- reviewBy has passed (re-check reachability, then extend or remove), or
- the package is not one of the entry's `packages`.
Every entry needs who accepted it, when, why, and where that was recorded.

advisories.reason: The flaw is in node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature VERIFICATION and no fixed release exists (latest is 1.4.0). The only user, src/supabase/functions/server/esign-pdf-protect.ts, creates signatures (key and self-signed certificate generation, PKCS#12 packaging, P12Signer's pkcs7 sign) and never verifies one, so the vulnerable path cannot be reached. @signpdf/signer-p12 is flagged only because it depends on node-forge.
